title: HR Magazine picks Incorruptible for its Best of HR Books, June 2026
summary: HR Magazine — the UK's leading HR publication — includes Incorruptible in its June 2026 Best of HR Books roundup, alongside Advita Patel's Decoding Confidence, Lyndsey Simpson's The Age Rebellion, Sarah Taylor's The Wellbeing Paradox, and Kerry-Lyn Stanton-Downes's Beyond Words. The roundup was published in the May/June 2026 edition of the magazine.
blockquote: How do we build companies that stay true to their mission once they succeed? That's the question entrepreneur and author Eric Ries asks in his new book, Incorruptible, in which he lays out the causes that lead organisations to drift from their values, and offers a blueprint to prevent this. He draws on numerous examples to help establish the need for purpose-driven leadership.
